source.scope: Liber IV, ix, source §§29–56 (28 lunar mansions), printed pp. 228–234
source.method: pdftotext -layout local edition text; line-wrap and clear OCR spacing artifacts normalized in Latin fields; source line locators retained
source.claim: Historical intended purposes, not empirically effective procedures or a Voynich translation.

rows.introductory_purpose_clause_latin: Prima harum est ad destruendum et depopulandum, que mansio Alnath nuncupatur.
body_additional_purposes: kill a named woman’s son; destroy him

body_roles.material: iron ring; liquid storax; black wax
body_roles.image: standing black man in hair shirt with a dart
body_roles.procedure_only: make, fumigate and seal the image; recite the name and petition

rows.introductory_purpose_clause_latin: Secunda mansio est Albotayn, et est ad auferendum iram.
body_additional_purposes: rectify the petitioner with the named person and fulfill petitions

body_roles.material: white wax; mastic; aloe wood fumigant
body_roles.procedure_only: image carried by operator

rows.introductory_purpose_clause_latin: Tercia mansio est Azoraye (id est, Pliades), et est ad acquirendum omne bonum.
body_additional_purposes: any good petition is permitted; petition is said to be completed

body_roles.image: seated, clothed woman with right hand over head
body_roles.procedure_only: silver ring with square top, worn on finger

rows.introductory_purpose_clause_latin: Quarta mansio est Aldebaran, et est ad acquirendum inimiciciam.
body_additional_purposes: separation and ill will are explicitly included in the petition

body_roles.procedure_only: name the requested petition

rows.introductory_purpose_clause_latin: Quinta mansio est Almizen, et est ut a regibus et officialibus bene recipiaris.
rows.purpose_latin: ut a regibus et officialibus bene recipiaris
rows.meaning_en: so that kings and officials receive you well
rows.meaning_de: damit Könige und Amtsträger dich gut aufnehmen
body_additional_purposes: a second use explicitly asks for a vision in sleep and an answer to a question

body_roles.image: head of a man without body
body_roles.procedure_only: write the petitioner’s request on the seal; put it under the head for sleep use

rows.introductory_purpose_clause_latin: Sexta mansio est Achaya, et est ad amorem inter duos ponendum.
rows.meaning_en: to place love between two people
rows.meaning_de: Liebe zwischen zwei Personen zu stiften
body_additional_purposes: the body specifies joining friendship and love between the two

body_roles.material: white wax; silk cloth; aloe wood; amber
body_roles.procedure_only: two images are wrapped together

rows.introductory_purpose_clause_latin: Septima mansio est Aldira, et est ad acquirendum omne bonum.
body_additional_purposes: generic good petition; the body repeats that the requested thing will occur

body_roles.image: praying man with hands raised to heaven
body_roles.procedure_only: name is written on the breast; seal is carried

rows.introductory_purpose_clause_latin: Octava mansio est Annathra, et est ad victoriam acquirendam.
body_additional_purposes: the image is held before an army and the text states that the operator will win and obtain

body_roles.procedure_only: hold the completed image before the army

rows.introductory_purpose_clause_latin: Nona mansio est Atarfa, et est ad infirmandum.
body_additional_purposes: two explicit alternatives: make a named daughter fall ill, or make blood flow from her; choose one

body_roles.image: man without a staff, hands over eyes
body_roles.procedure_only: the source explicitly says one of the two alternatives is to be requested

rows.introductory_purpose_clause_latin: Decima mansio est Algebha, et est ad sanandum infirmos et facere leviter parere mulierem.
rows.purpose_latin: ad sanandum infirmos et facere leviter parere mulierem
rows.meaning_en: to heal the sick and make a woman give birth easily
rows.meaning_de: Kranke zu heilen und einer Frau eine leichte Geburt zu ermöglichen
body_additional_purposes: healing applies to anyone eating or drinking liquid washed with the seal; the same wash is given to a woman in labor

body_roles.procedure_only: carry the seal or wash it and administer the wash

rows.introductory_purpose_clause_latin: Undecima mansio est Azobra, et est ut timearis et bene recipiaris.
rows.meaning_en: so that you are feared and well received
rows.meaning_de: damit du gefürchtet und gut aufgenommen wirst
body_additional_purposes: glory, fear by all who see the operator, placating rulers, reception and honor are all stated

body_roles.image: man riding a lion with a dart
body_roles.procedure_only: carry the tablet

rows.introductory_purpose_clause_latin: Duodecima mansio est Azarfa, et est ad separandum duos ab invicem se diligentes.
rows.purpose_latin: ad separandum duos ab invicem se diligentes
rows.meaning_en: to separate two people who love each other
body_additional_purposes: the body restates disjoining and separating named people

body_roles.procedure_only: bury the image at a chosen place

rows.introductory_purpose_clause_latin: Tercia decima mansio est Alahue, et est ad solvendum hominem qui cum muliere agere non potest et ad inter virum et mulierem ponendum amorem.
rows.purpose_latin: ad solvendum hominem qui cum muliere agere non potest et ad inter virum et mulierem ponendum amorem
rows.meaning_en: to release an impotent man and place love between a man and a woman
rows.meaning_de: einen impotenten Mann zu lösen und Liebe zwischen Mann und Frau zu stiften
body_additional_purposes: two cases: a woman carrying the images becomes loved; a bound man carrying them becomes able to have intercourse

body_roles.material: red and white wax; aloe; amber; rose water; white silk
body_roles.procedure_only: write the requested person’s name on each image and carry them

rows.introductory_purpose_clause_latin: Quarta decima mansio est Azimech, et est ad separandum hominem a muliere.
rows.meaning_en: to separate a man from a woman
rows.meaning_de: einen Mann von einer Frau zu trennen
body_additional_purposes: the body explicitly adds enmity and ill will to the separation

body_roles.procedure_only: name the persons and bury the image

rows.introductory_purpose_clause_latin: Quinta decima mansio est Algafra, et est ad acquirendum amiciciam et bonam voluntatem.
rows.purpose_latin: ad acquirendum amiciciam et bonam voluntatem
body_additional_purposes: the body expands this to conjunction of friendship, love and goodwill

body_roles.image: seated man holding a paper as if reading
body_roles.procedure_only: carry the image

rows.introductory_purpose_clause_latin: Sexta decima mansio est Azebene, et est ad lucrandum in mercimoniis (videlicet, in vendere et emere).
rows.purpose_latin: ad lucrandum in mercimoniis (videlicet, in vendere et emere)
rows.meaning_en: to profit in commerce (namely selling and buying)
rows.meaning_de: im Handel Gewinn zu machen (nämlich beim Verkaufen und Kaufen)

body_roles.procedure_only: show the plate to the stars for seven nights

rows.introductory_purpose_clause_latin: Septima decima mansio est Alichil, et est ut latro non intret domum ad aliquid furandum ibidem.
rows.purpose_latin: ut latro non intret domum ad aliquid furandum ibidem
rows.meaning_en: so that a thief does not enter the house to steal
rows.meaning_de: damit kein Dieb ins Haus eindringt, um dort zu stehlen
body_additional_purposes: the spoken body broadens protection to all possessions and excludes any bad man or thief

body_roles.material: iron seal; monkey hair and female-mouse hair; monkey skin
body_roles.image: monkey with hand on its shoulder
body_roles.procedure_only: bury in the house

rows.introductory_purpose_clause_latin: Octava decima mansio est Alcab, et est ad febrem et ventris dolorem auferendum.
rows.purpose_latin: ad febrem et ventris dolorem auferendum
rows.meaning_en: to remove fever and belly pain
body_additional_purposes: the body also gives a house-protection use against snakes and other bad beasts; carrying it is said to heal fever or belly pain

body_roles.image: serpent holding its tail over its head
body_roles.procedure_only: bury the image in a vessel for house protection; carry it for illness

rows.introductory_purpose_clause_latin: Nona decima mansio est Axaula, et est ad faciendum currere sanguinem ex muliere.
rows.purpose_latin: ad faciendum currere sanguinem ex muliere
rows.meaning_en: to make blood flow from a woman
body_additional_purposes: a woman binding the image on her thighs is alternatively said to give birth easily and safely

body_roles.image: woman holding hands over her face
body_roles.procedure_only: name the woman in the utterance

rows.introductory_purpose_clause_latin: Vicesima mansio est Alnaym, et est ad venandum in terra.
body_additional_purposes: the body says all terrestrial game comes to the operator and can then be captured

body_roles.image: human head and hands on a four-legged horse body, holding a bow
body_roles.procedure_only: carry the image

rows.introductory_purpose_clause_latin: Vicesima prima mansio est Albelda, et est ad destruendum.
body_additional_purposes: the body specifies evacuating a named place and destroying it

body_roles.material: image in copper vessel; sulfur; amber; hair
body_roles.procedure_only: bury the image and materials underground at the chosen place

rows.introductory_purpose_clause_latin: Vicesima secunda mansio est . . . .

body_roles.procedure_only: explicit source lacuna; no heading or prescription recoverable here

rows.introductory_purpose_clause_latin: Vicesima tercia mansio est Zaadebola, et est ad destruendum et devastandum.
body_additional_purposes: the body repeats evacuate, destroy and devastate for a named place

body_roles.procedure_only: show seal to stars when mansion rises, then bury it

rows.introductory_purpose_clause_latin: Vicesima quart a mansio est Caadazod, et est ad augmentandum armenta.
body_additional_purposes: ram and cow herds use different horns/animal placements; increase is paired with prevention of mortality

body_roles.material: castrated ram horn, or ox horn for cattle
body_roles.procedure_only: fit the image on a ram or bull’s neck according to herd type

rows.introductory_purpose_clause_latin: Vicesima quinta mansio est Zaadalahbia, et est ad custodiendum arbores et messes a malis occasionibus.
rows.purpose_latin: ad custodiendum arbores et messes a malis occasionibus
rows.meaning_en: to guard trees and crops from bad occurrences
rows.meaning_de: Bäume und Ernten vor schädlichen Ereignissen zu schützen
body_additional_purposes: the body explicitly asks that harvest and trees suffer no damage or bad occurrence

body_roles.procedure_only: place the image in the tree at the location to be guarded

rows.introductory_purpose_clause_latin: Vicesima sexta mansio est Alfarg primus, et est ad generandum amorem.
body_additional_purposes: the body specifies drawing the operator toward love and friendship of a named woman

body_roles.material: white wax; mastic; fragrant fumigation; vessel/bussula
body_roles.image: woman with loose hair and a vessel
body_roles.procedure_only: carry the buried image

rows.introductory_purpose_clause_latin: Vicesima septima mansio est Alfarg posterior, et est ad damnificandum balneum.
body_additional_purposes: the body gives the concrete result that nobody will come there to bathe

body_roles.image: winged man holding an empty perforated vessel to his mouth
body_roles.procedure_only: bury the baked image in the bathhouse

rows.introductory_purpose_clause_latin: Vicesima octava mansio est Arrexe, et est ad congregandum pisces ad locum unum.
rows.purpose_latin: ad congregandum pisces ad locum unum
rows.meaning_en: to gather fish to one place
rows.meaning_de: Fische an einem Ort zu versammeln
body_additional_purposes: all fish around the place gather there and can then be captured at will

body_roles.procedure_only: tie the seal to a thread and throw it into the water

global_notes: Rows 3 (Azoraye/Pliades) and 7 (Aldira) have exactly the same headline purpose, ad acquirendum omne bonum; they remain separate rows and are not synonym-collapsed.
Row 22 (§50) is an explicit source lacuna (Vicesima secunda mansio est . . . .); name, purpose and body are UNKNOWN.
Materials, depicted images and spirit/domain names are recorded under body_roles and are not treated as the heading purpose.
Body_additional_purposes records explicit extensions or alternative cases in the prescription. Procedure, timing, carrying, fumigation and burial are not promoted to purposes.

No body passage explicitly reverses or contradicts its heading result, so explicit_inversion is false for all rows. negative_or_reverse_valence separately marks headings whose stated intended result is destructive, separative, afflictive or damaging; ordinary negations (nec/non) remain body consequences.
§57 gives a general placement rule for names/petitions after the 28 rows; it is outside the extracted purpose headings and is not folded into any row.
summary: All 28 IV.ix mansion purpose clauses were extracted from the local Pingree 1986 PDF text for §§29–56, pp. 228–234. The repeated headline for rows 3 and 7 is preserved verbatim as a meaningful textual repetition; row 22 remains UNKNOWN because the source itself is lacunose. Each row separates the intended result from material, image, spirit-name and procedure fields, and flags explicit multi-purpose, negative/reverse-valence, and variable-case language in the body.
